Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it as the claimant, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was in the parking lot of a grocery store here in Conroe, Texas. I had just pulled into a spcae near the front
entrance.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I was backing out of the space, slowly, looking over my shoulder. I was almost completely out when another
vehicle came down the aisle and hit the rear driver's side of my car.
Q: How fast would you estimate the other vehicle was going?
A: Not fast, maybe walking speed or a little quicker. It wasn't a high-speed hit, but I definitely felt it.
Q: Did you hit your head or lose consciousness?
A: I hit the side of my head on the window frame. I didn't pass out, but I felt dizzy and nauseous for a whlie afterward.
Q: Have you received medical treatment since the collision?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. They diagnosed a concussion and told me to rest and
avoid screens as much as possible.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?
A: Some. I get headaches in the late afternoon and I've had trouble concentrating at work. My doctor has me on a
gradual return schedule.
Q: Did anyone witness the collision?
A: I believe a shopper nearby saw it, but I didn't get their contact information at the time.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm still recovering, and I'd appreciate it if you could keep me updated on the claim.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>
